title: Robust inference for risk heterogeneity under group imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2606.00797v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Population-level heterogeneity is ubiquitous in biomedical data, where differences across demographic or clinical subgroups can substantially alter risk patterns. For example, in intensive care unit (ICU) studies, the mortality risk associated with specific admission diagnoses can vary across ethnic groups. Existing approaches for detecting risk heterogeneity are often sensitive to baseline model misspecification and regularization bias, both of which commonly arise in practice. In this paper, we propose a robust framework for inferring risk heterogeneity between two populations using Neyman orthogonality, which yields estimators that are locally insensitive to nuisance parameter estimation error. The proposed estimator is consistent and asymptotically normal, and simulation studies demonstrate that in finite samples our method substantially reduces bias and improves inferential stability compared with standard likelihood-based

translated_title: 组别失衡下风险异质性的稳健推断
translated_abstract: 总体层面的异质性在生物医学数据中普遍存在，人口统计学或临床亚组之间的差异可能会显著改变风险模式。例如，在重症监护病房（ICU）研究中，与特定入院诊断相关的死亡风险可能因种族群体而异。现有的风险异质性检测方法往往对基线模型的误设和正则化偏差敏感，而这两种问题在实践中经常出现。本文提出了一种利用Neyman正交性来推断两个总体之间风险异质性的稳健框架，该方法所得到的估计量对冗余参数的估计误差具有局部不敏感性。所提出的估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，仿真研究表明，在有限样本条件下，与基于标准似然的方法相比，我们的方法显著降低了偏差并提高了推断的稳定性。
tldr: 提出一种基于Neyman正交性的稳健框架，用于在组别失衡情形下推断两个总体间的风险异质性，有效降低偏差并提升有限样本下的推断稳定性。
en_tdlr: A robust framework based on Neyman orthogonality is proposed for inferring risk heterogeneity between two populations under group imbalance, substantially reducing bias and improving inferential stability in finite samples.
